card.name: The ending of ARBs in drug lists
card.fires_on: The final piece "Bs" of the abbreviation ARBs, which comes after ACE inhibitors in interaction warnings. It also fires more weakly on a few other word endings, such as "inhibitor" and "Interaction", in drug-interaction text.

modes.label: ARBs abbreviation
modes.description: The "Bs" ending of ARBs, listed next to ACE inhibitors or aliskiren.
modes.example: Do not co-administer FILSPARI with AR<<Bs>>, ERAs, or aliskiren

modes.label: Interaction wording
modes.description: Words like inhibitor or Interaction in drug-interaction headings and sentences.
